templates.name: Risk assessment report elements
templates.note: Appendix K of the publication; NIST calls these elements examples, not a required template.
outline: Executive summary: date of the assessment, purpose, scope, whether it is an initial or subsequent assessment, overall level of risk, and the number of risks at each level

Body of the report: purpose and the questions the assessment answers; assumptions and constraints; risk tolerance inputs; risk model and analytic approach; threat sources, threat events, vulnerabilities and predisposing conditions, likelihood, impact and risk for each threat event, set out in a risk table
Supporting appendices: references and sources, the assessment team, detailed risk tables and supporting data
